thread_text:
1. Price Hike Hidden?

Peacock quietly raises all tiers, but grandfathered users might not feel it yet.

2. Who Pays More?

New subscribers face the full increase, while long-time users get a temporary pass.

3. Check Your Bill

Your next statement reveals if you're grandfathered or facing the new rates.

4. Budget Alert

If you're not exempt, your monthly streaming cost just jumped—plan accordingly.

5. Act Now

Compare your current plan with alternatives this week. Will you upgrade, downgrade, or switch?

instagram.caption:
Your Peacock bill is about to go up—every single plan, from the ad-supported tier to Premium, is getting more expensive. 💸

The price hike hits all tiers, but there's a catch: if you're a grandfathered subscriber, you might be spared for now. New subscribers face the full increase immediately, while long-time users get a temporary pass.

Check your next statement this month—it will tell you exactly which group you're in. If you're not exempt, your monthly streaming cost just jumped, so plan your budget accordingly.

For anyone creating content or managing subscriptions, this is a direct hit to your monthly toolkit costs.

Before the new rate kicks in, will you upgrade, downgrade, or switch to another service this week? ⏳
